article.title: Firm, body corporate or association not to be appointed as inspector.
article.content:
215Firm, body corporate or association not to be appointed as inspector.

Section 215  ·  Chapter XIV  ·  page 144 of the Act
No firm, body corporate or other association shall be appointed as an inspector.
